description: This file contains SQL schema definitions, indexes, triggers, policies, and extensions for a Noteshare platform using PostgreSQL. It defines tables for user profiles, notes, likes, bookmarks, and associated indexes, along with policies for access control and triggers for user synchronization.

methods.name: public.handle_new_user()
methods.description: Trigger function that upserts user profiles when a new user is created in the auth.users table.
